column1: # Rows db.rf1.* (line DBID item rf-1, 2026-11-27; DBID DECISIONS 62 (22); fixtures make_multidb.py --rf1-only): a query batch whose subjects' loads look up a taxid (bsub, 9606) with BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/btd_empty, an empty taxdb.btd, which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 maps as a null pointer: the lookup reads a record and NCBI crashes (SIGSEGV, exit 139) at that load, in every program and at 1 and 4 threads. LOSAT refuses there (rule 3 of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS) after the reports of the batches before, as for NCBI's own error of a batch (blastinput::app::ErrorAfterBatchReports, made in one place: algorithm::common::database::batch_loads_error): .b2. BATCH_SIZE=1, rf1_q0e (q0_nohit, then bsub's letters, whose batch's prefetch loads bsub); .r2. BATCH_SIZE=1 PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=0, rf1_re (pfo_r, then bsub's letters, whose report loads bsub; outfmt 0 with -num_alignments 0, as NCBI's run with the alignments ends at pfo_r's first alignment, exit 2); .b1.0 one batch (psiblast, which searches each query alone: rf1_e, bsub's letters), the prolog; all with -evalue 1e-10. Each takes its stdout from the first bytes of NCBI's run of the batches before alone (.q0., .r.), its end left out as NCBI's own error of that batch leaves it.
